problems: The blind guess reads it as a leaping quadruped with a wavy ground line, which is close but does not read as a ram. The horns are the only ram cue, and they are thin lines, so the figure could be taken for a hare or deer.

The figure is mostly gold stick lines (head to horns, spine from 303,235 to 305,315, diagonal to hind hoof at 372,397). The blue outline is thin and only loosely traces the body, so it reads as a wireframe rather than a solid silhouette.
The horns are two long diagonals reaching far from the head (left tip 202,138; right tip 357,107), so they look like antennae rather than curled ram horns.
The ram's eye label sits on the blue outline at the head, the 'withers at the base of the n' label is truncated, and the 'wave-top' and 'wave-top where the foreleg m' labels overlap.
The foreleg star 60000 at about (280,338) floats above the wave instead of reaching into it. The wave line passes at about y=400-430, so 'lifted over the wave' does not show.
Only the hind hoof (372,397) sits near the wave on the right. The foam star 70638 at (181,470) is isolated from the figure.
Back star 58905 and belly star 58484 sit on the gold spine, and the head is at the left with the hind end at the lower right, so the figure is upright and the placement there is sensible.
output.advice: Redraw so the ram reads clearly as a ram. (1) Head: keep the eye star 65468 near (175,230) and draw a closed head outline around it. (2) Horns: start both from the crown star 61199 (about 263,150) and curl them outward and back as spirals ending at the left horn tip 63613 (202,138) and the right horn tip 57696 (357,107), so they hug the head. (3) Body: draw a closed filled torso from the withers 59151 (about 303,235) along the back 58905 to the hind end, with the belly 58484 (about 305,315) on its underside. (4) Foreleg: draw the leg from the body down-left to the foreleg star 60000 at about (280,338), then angle it down to the wave-top 69896 (about 157,405) so the leg visibly rests in the wave. (5) Wave: draw a continuous crest from the far wave-crest 72370 (about 102,377) through wave-top 70248 (about 143,385) down to the foam 70638 (about 181,470), with the hind hoof 52633 (about 372,397) in the surf at the wave's right end. (6) Labels: move the eye and withers labels off the outline, and stagger the two wave-top labels so they do not overlap.
